mapper.select: SELECT t.login_id, t.open_date, t.company_nm, t.person_nm, st.nm AS status_nm, lm.nm AS login_mode_nm, t.ip_address, t.os, t.browser FROM ( SELECT sys26_login_id AS login_id , sys26_open_date , TO_CHAR(sys26_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS open_date , (SELECT sys01_company_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id) AS company_nm , emp01_kor_nm ||'('||emp01_emp_no||')' AS person_nm , sys26_status_cd AS status_cd , sys26_login_mode AS login_mode , sys26_ip_address AS ip_address , sys26_os AS os , sys26_browser AS browser FROM sys26_login INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = sys26_person_id WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', sys26_open_date) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('day', #{startDate}::timestamp) AND DATE_TRUNC('day', #{closeDate}::timestamp) AND CAST(emp01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys26_login_mode, 'P') LIKE #{loginMode} AND sys26_status_cd != '20' UNION ALL SELECT sys26_login_id , sys26_open_date , TO_CHAR(sys26_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , (SELECT sys01_company_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = sys02_company_id) , sys02_kor_nm ||'('||sys02_login_id||')' , sys26_status_cd , sys26_login_mode , sys26_ip_address , sys26_os , sys26_browser FROM sys26_login INNER JOIN sys02_user ON sys02_user_id = sys26_person_id WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', sys26_open_date) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('day', #{startDate}::timestamp) AND DATE_TRUNC('day', #{closeDate}::timestamp) AND CAST(sys02_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys26_login_mode, 'P') LIKE #{loginMode} AND sys26_status_cd = '20' ) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT cd, f_cdnm('LoginStatusCode', cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS nm FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sys26_status_cd AS cd FROM sys26_login) x) st ON st.cd = t.status_cd LEFT JOIN (SELECT cd, f_cdnm('LoginModeCode', cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS nm FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sys26_login_mode AS cd FROM sys26_login) x) lm ON lm.cd = t.login_mode ORDER BY t.sys26_open_date DESC
